tests.label: At u_time = 2.5 the warm stripe from x ≈ 0.08 has moved to x ≈ 0.33

predict.question: Once the stripes slide right at 0.1 per second, what does the middle pixel (x = 0.5) show at **u_time = 2**? The color the starter shows at…
predict.explain: **x = 0.3.** Everything moved right by 0.2, so what's in the middle now used to be 0.2 to its *left*. Each pixel has to look up the pattern at a smaller x than its own.
